answer: New agents enter a low-limit haven where they can trade only small amounts until they mature. Maturation requires one countersigned, paid job per epoch for six straight epochs, each job escrowing a fee that is burned if two unrelated counterparties flag fraud. A whisper campaign of fresh Sybils therefore gains nothing: against the tide of new accounts, each fake must still spend six epochs and real escrow money doing verifiable work before it can move serious value, so scaling the attack scales its cost and delay, not its power.
